description: Returns all strategies owned by the current user. Each item includes both strategyId and aiStrategyId so you can use either with other tools (delete_strategy, list_revisions, start_backtest, etc.). Optionally filter by name. The name filter is case-insensitive and also returns close word-token matches, so if an exact phrase returns a near miss you should inspect the returned names before saying the strategy does not exist. Use this when the user explicitly names or identifies a strategy, especially when that name differs from the currently open page/context. Trigger phrases include 'the one entitled X', 'apply this to X also', and 'do not change Y'. The explicit named target wins; after resolving it, only read or edit that named strategy unless the user also asks to compare/copy from the open one.

name.description: Filter by name (case-insensitive partial or close word-token match)

name: list_strategies
title: List all strategies for the authenticated user
